channel.title: Homeworld Press
channel.description: Independent editorial coverage of sci-fi literature, technology, space science, and tested buyer's guides.

item.title: A Deep-Water Salp Forces Old Nets To Account for Absences
item.description: The load-bearing claim is an adverb about depth, and the evidence that would settle it is a set of shallow hauls nobody has published yet.

item.title: A New Hubble Frame Turns a Known Galaxy Into a Calibration Test
item.description: A repeat visit to a heavily photographed galaxy wins on one axis only, and that axis is measurement error.

item.title: Far-Side Moon Rocks Test Where the Lunar Timeline Was Drawn
item.description: Whether the impact record changes depends on one measurement this release does not contain.

item.title: Playing a Violin Changes the Player Before the Wood
item.description: A violin's measured resonances are set by geometry, mass and stiffness. What players call break-in lives in bridge feet, humidity cycles and strings, which is a different claim.

item.title: Hidden Companions Move the Flux a Calibration Standard Was Meant to Hold
item.description: A pulsing reference star is a small discovery with a long administrative tail, and the interesting part is that the sample caught it at all.

item.title: Grown Mars Walls Wait on a Reactor Nobody Has Flown
item.description: A November report pairs microbial cementation with surface nuclear power. The binding constraints are water and unattended time.

item.title: The Physics Prior Can Outvote the Measurement It Was Built to Fix
item.description: Reconstruction from sparse, noisy particle images turns on a weighting choice that no benchmark shows

item.title: Spacecraft Data Track Fourteen Years of Motion in the Solar System's Tail
item.description: A tail that moves turns a boundary nobody has visited into a reading of the gas outside the Sun's bubble.

item.title: Blade Runner 2099 Swaps Who Holds the Clipboard
item.description: Amazon's eight-episode return keeps the franchise's question about personhood and moves the pressure to the side of the desk that now gives the orders.

item.title: The Last Soviet Mars Probe Left an Archive Nobody Can Open
item.description: Reading the surviving accounts of the mission means trusting a summary of a summary, and the raw frames are not there to settle it.
